name: The audit page's filters over what left the network, and the portal's reader pages

mutants.name: the portal's run passes the built-in readers whatever its host registered
the portal resolves no reader registry and always uses the built-ins
the audit filter matches every row, so a filtered page is not filtered
mutants.old: AND (@left IS NULL OR (e.model_location IS NOT DISTINCT FROM @hosted) = @left)
mutants.new: AND (@left IS NULL OR (e.model_location IS NOT DISTINCT FROM @hosted) IS NOT NULL)

mutants.name: the older link drops the filter, so page two answers another question
the source form drops the owner it was given
mutants.old: var owner = Guid.TryParse(form["owner"].ToString(), out var id) ? id : (Guid?)null;
mutants.new: var owner = Guid.TryParse(form["owner"].ToString(), out var id) && false ? id : (Guid?)null;

mutants.name: a profile folder that is gone reads as no drift instead of not compared
mutants.old:
if (!Directory.Exists(folder))
            return $"not compared: {folder} is not on this machine";
mutants.new:
if (!Directory.Exists(folder))
            return "none: the settings, sources and rules match the profile";
